items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was working with Joe Jones, Philly Joe, at a bar up in North Philadelphia.

ctx.x: And in ’49, it was late ’49, I was working with Joe Jones, Philly Joe, at a bar up in North Philadelphia. We used to go to an all night movie, air conditioned movie, after we get off, sweatin’ and what not, and I got pneumonia. First time I’ve been to the hospital in all my life. And June had already moved to New York to find employment in a record shop in New York, what she’d been doing in Philadelphia, she had managed this record [shop]. Impossible! Have to be bonded, [an] un-bonded female couldn’t get a job…
